body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## Finding

GAP-07 (Major), F00.2 verdict of this audit: **PARTIAL**.

- Resolution claimed in F00.2: Master T-ID table, timer service, PRNG, budgets
- "Addressed in" check: {'ok': True, 'note': 'docs/architecture/08_timing.md exists: F08.1 master T-ID table (:11-45, about 30 rows incl. the MAAP/MRP/NVM/TX-aging additions), section 3 timer hardware + PRNG + sim-only time-compression hook (:50-72), section 4 deadline budgets F08.3 (:74-103), :47-48 records that the 187.5 ms figure is superseded. The document says what the Resolution claims; the budgets half is not realized in hdl (see hdl_evidence).'}
- "Verified by" claimed: TIM
- In `hdl/` today: PARTLY. Implemented: timer service hdl/common/KL_pp_timer_service.sv:43-51 (prescaler DIV_US_P/DIV_MS_P), :164-191 (deadline RAM sweep, wrap-safe age compare); PRNG hdl/common/KL_pp_prng.sv:12-21 (kinds 0-7 = every F08.2 range), :117 (seed = entity_id XOR counter, latched once); derived slot map hdl/common/pp_pkg.sv:188 pp_timer_map(), owner tags :243-252; constants: hdl/adp/pp_adp_pkg.sv:47 (T-ADP-ADV 5000), hdl/acmp/pp_acmp_pkg.sv:135-137 (200/4000/10000), hdl/acmp/KL_acmp_talker.sv:128 (DAFRESH 15000), hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_ca_originator.sv:117 (250 ms), hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_notify.sv:158/:160 (300_000 / 60_000), :655 (monitor = PRNG kind 4), :792 (1000 ms counter limiter), hdl/srp/KL_srp_top.sv:73-77 (200/1000/5000), hdl/acmp/KL_acmp_nvm_shadow.sv:102 (DEB_TICKS_P 500), hdl/packet_engine/KL_pp_tx_arbiter.sv:67 (AGING_MS_P 10). NOT implemented: (1) the budgets / deadline engine: pp_txn_t.deadline is stamped at hdl/packet_engine/KL_pp_normalizer.sv:139 from BUDGET_*_MS_C (hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:702-704) and is read by NOTHING in hdl/ (grep 'deadline' finds no consumer), and the scoreboard rule (e) kill face is tied off at the top: protocol_processor_top.sv:852-854 (.kill_valid_i(1'b0), .kill_id_i(3'd0), .kill_resp_queued_i(1'b0)); the ucpu has no deadline input, E_FAILSAFE (hdl/aecp/ucode/gen_ucode.py:365) is reached only as a refusal arm (:1930-1932), never by a deadline expiry. So T-AECP-RESP 240 ms and T-BUDGET-* are documentation plus a dead field, and 03 section 4 / 06 section 8 'deadline engine preempts' is unrealized. (2) T-IDENT-BURST and T-IDENT-REARM: no RTL (grep identify_notif/ident_burst in hdl: only the command-refusal decode KL_aecp_engine.sv:579/:1154; pp_pkg.sv:180 names the singleton slots only in a comment). (3) T-CTR-OBSERVE: no RTL (counter banks are the integrator's, no observation-tick latch in hdl/).
- In `tb/` today: There is no single TIM suite over F08.1; timing is graded piecemeal by compressed-time or injected-expiry module suites. Row by row: T-ADP-ADV tb/adp_engine/sim_main.cpp:469,496 (+pp_top S3); T-ADP-DELAY / -START adp_engine P1/P3/P8 (:429,:481,:664-669) against the real PRNG, and tb/prng kinds 1-2; T-ADP-NOADP adp_engine P9a/P9i/P9j (:698,:813,:825); T-ACMP-CMD/RETRY/NOTK/DELAY exact deadlines in the tb/acmp_listener walk (README :18-19, sim_main.cpp:981-1011); T-AECP-TIMEOUT 250 ms + one retry tb/pp_top U10 (README :369-385) and tb/originator (port-supplied timeout); T-NOTIF-MONITOR pp_top U10 (30-60 s draw run through the real timer service at 1 ms = 100 clk) + tb/prng kind 4; T-NOTIF-TIMELIMITED pp_top U5 (sim_main.cpp:3977) and T-LOCK-UNLOCK pp_top L6d (:4337) -- BOTH only with the parameter overridden to 400 ms in tb/pp_top/pp_top_wrap.sv:322-323, so the 300 s / 60 s defaults themselves are never graded; T-CTR-NOTIF pp_top U9 (:4092-4094); T-SRP-DAFRESH and T-SRP-LEAVEALL2 tb/acmp_talker (README :29-35, mutation M2 halves the backoff -> 4 FAIL); T-MAAP-PROBE/ANNOUNCE tb/maap (README :7-18, real PRNG kinds 5/6 + compressed timer service); T-MRP-JOIN/LEAVE/LEAVEALL/PERIODIC tb/srp_top (README :12-13,:54-58,:70) + tb/srp_stream_fsms (:41); T-NVM-DEBOUNCE tb/acmp_nvm (Makefile :11 -GDEB_TICKS_P=50, README :25, M1); T-TX-AGING tb/tx_arbiter (README :23-27, M1); timebase itself tb/timer_service (-GDIV_US_P=4 -GDIV_MS_P=5, 48 checks, M1-M3), slot map tb/timer_map (1187 checks), PRNG tb/prng (57 checks; its README covers kinds 0-4 only, kinds 5-7 are graded in tb/maap). UNEXERCISED: T-IDENT-BURST, T-IDENT-REARM, T-CTR-OBSERVE (no RTL, no test); T-AECP-RESP 240 ms and T-BUDGET-ACMP-RESP have no assertion anywhere (grep '50 ms|BUDGET_ACMP' in tb finds only tb/dispatch stamping the field); the only response-budget measurement is pp_top B4/B4b (sim_main.cpp:2764-2808): ONE memory-backed READ_DESCRIPTOR response against 100 ms -- no histogram, no worst case (full GET_DYNAMIC_INFO batch, 16-way fan-out contention) and no ACMP budget; F09.4's 'deadline expiry mid-command -> forced FAIL_SAFE' case has no top-level test (tb/scoreboard grades rule (e) on the module's kill ports only, README :30,:52, which the top ties to 0).

## What remains

1) Implement the 08 section 4 budgets: consume pp_txn_t.deadline, drive the scoreboard kill face (protocol_processor_top.sv:852-854 is tied 0) and the 06 section 8 forced FAIL_SAFE respond, or strike the deadline engine from 03 section 4 / 06 section 8 / 08 section 4 and F09.4 and delete the dead field. 2) TIM coverage for the budget rows: assert T-AECP-RESP <= 240 ms and T-BUDGET-ACMP-RESP <= 50 ms under worst-case stimulus (oversize READ_DESCRIPTOR, full GDI batch, 16-way fan-out), and a compressed-timer test of deadline expiry mid-command. 3) T-IDENT-BURST / T-IDENT-REARM have no RTL and no test (rides on the identify machinery GAP-06 leaves open); T-CTR-OBSERVE has no RTL owner in this repository. 4) T-NOTIF-TIMELIMITED and T-LOCK-UNLOCK are only exercised with the parameter overridden to 400 ms: add a check that pins the 300_000 / 60_000 defaults (or run them through prescaler compression instead of a value override).

## Acceptance

1. pp_txn_t.deadline has a consumer in hdl/ that drives the scoreboard kill face and a forced FAIL_SAFE response, or the deadline engine is removed from 03 s4, 06 s8, 08 s4 and F09.4 with the field deleted
2. A compressed-timer pp_top arm stalls a command past its budget and demands a well-formed forced response (never a silent retire), with a mutation record
3. A suite asserts AECP response latency <= 240 ms and ACMP <= 50 ms under the 08 s4 worst-case stimuli, not only the single B4/B4b READ_DESCRIPTOR measurement
4. F08.1 rows with no RTL (T-IDENT-BURST, T-IDENT-REARM, T-CTR-OBSERVE) are either implemented and graded or marked integrator-owned/not landed in F08.1; the 300 s / 60 s defaults are pinned by a check

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
title: GAP-07: 08 s4 budgets are unrealized: txn deadline is never read, scoreboard kill face tied off at the top
